facts.fact: ACTPOL says Egypt's law allows transfers abroad only to destinations with equal protection and with a licence from the Centre, and the regulations of 1 November 2025 add the data subject's consent, with compliance due about 1 November 2026.
facts.system: Law No. 151 of 2020 and Decree No. 816 of 2025

facts.fact: ACTPOL says the regulations provide no standard contractual clauses and Egypt has not published a list of countries with adequate protection.
